result.markdown:
For most small businesses, **QuickBooks Online is the best overall accounting software**\. However, if you're a Canadian small business, there are a few alternatives worth considering depending on your size, budget, and how you operate.

Here are my top picks for 2026.

## Best accounting software compared

![QuickBooks Online Subscription
– Youngblüm Consulting, LLC](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ZgHrB8oigEufRyuFGAnJb5xLCv8JTTFTuh-tJroDHKA-im6xXYHUKY5IyXqMXAn4XiAmA9iGGDzvBmRzmuCP5nnYiezowZhOKrQixuB8tQOCn-kwmHGQPey_5_wckO7vbwWRLyIGGAJrospfP2duINJHsMT-PeUh6ztD0dM7ZAm_N6XnyQYoxFtq7J7pZOxm?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. QuickBooks Online**

(Best overall)

Approximately C\$20–\$220/month depending on plan

- Income and expense tracking
- Bank account integration
- GST/HST tracking
- Payroll and inventory options
- Excellent accountant compatibility

Best for businesses that want a complete accounting system.

[QuickBooks website](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/ca/)

---

![Xero – AccountKit Support Center](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/HOFZdHQfaXHdQ0Jl6FhQm1ZL8WDa2JXXY2s_IDNQw6_ClmY--iV2XW1k6Glaj1ICzU7IfOAztiKsPODuDYTSIw6PRmUslgzmZ5aMlPuGROKkGMtSJzGnCUzu5B8zEx6lZO3rd6Y_GILZvoN2_MXkKzeqqLSGOUSO0lv-UiE7fZFfvbCSDizWo5sdMixvhee4?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Xero**

(Best for growing businesses)

Approximately C\$25–\$80/month

- Unlimited users on all plans
- Excellent bank reconciliation
- Financial reporting
- GST/HST support
- Good accountant collaboration

Best if several employees or bookkeepers need access.

[Xero website](https://www.xero.com/ca/)

---

![FreshBooks Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RRvX6v49QkXlAnGf7iI3zuYuHq4Y5bCV2ND2uEGJjfjlSbrrgGFSfhAMTnFz47xKgD07CO5bDVnhMBo6jF3Yychs84_UW4qLs93k9PAEnaI8Kmr_xSKldMl1tHK69I4mDHX1xQ085ifzPdaKSnwyxyG_Y5668gw33P8XIfpZgJ8Lv3nST9TCXoqpEHKBFC7o?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. FreshBooks**

(Best for freelancers)

Approximately C\$26–\$72/month

- Very easy invoicing
- Expense tracking
- Time tracking
- Client billing
- GST/HST support

Best for consultants, contractors and service businesses.

[FreshBooks website](https://www.freshbooks.com/)

---

![Free Wave Financial Inc. Logo Vector Download | Logowik](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tnsMywbhmGAbFqPGr6O6DRlr31UIPIOPlNOMdf6um-89wvuooxUnVR2zBx_BWRY62sU-oEIrmhWudT2Iq__WN2d_uJSl7RY3WikgQVspfhcPs3tKMFKFs5Xx7GT_25_4ERvIXrsRVuZT0eEu7vba7OwhSfn0VtBIomBp5nrMl6pAjSavjUdtqHSynMOahhsM?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Wave Accounting**

(Best free option)

Free plan; Pro approximately C\$25/month

- Basic bookkeeping
- Invoicing
- Income and expense tracking
- Canadian sales tax support

Best for a new business or sole proprietor keeping costs low.

[Wave website](https://www.waveapps.com/)

---

!["Best 10 Zoho Apps for Small Businesses in 2024 - Must-Have Tools" | C3 Solutions](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/QMBJut4kUVy6UNtA0DcEcpSKElNdEgHfabBOoR3AWTMUo6phHjAJ01KBTRk_iU44CUuVy6AD0OeM48UFtluYC3mtudqFVjYFesk47WQPcQQfsgxz1-Ctp0z-lODm5vgYFvDQ7IEjwcEwqAsNX1booH4Twqog2tqxnwaLYmRuRR9TviU8hG6khxNJKfVoO6Q2?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Zoho Books**

(Best value)

Free plan available; paid plans from approximately C\$20/month

- Invoicing and bookkeeping
- Expense management
- Automation
- Financial reports
- Integrates with other Zoho applications

Best for businesses wanting affordable, connected business software.

[Zoho Books website](https://www.zoho.com/ca/books/)

| Retail or inventory business | QuickBooks |
| Construction or contracting | QuickBooks or Xero |
| Consulting business | FreshBooks |
| New business on a tight budget | Wave |
| Growing business with multiple users | Xero |
